Extraction: Keep the gauze in place for 30-45 minutes.
Do not rinse or spit forcefully for 24 hours.
Apply ice pack to the face if swelling occurs.
Root Canal: Do not eat until the numbness wears off.
Mild sensitivity is normal for 2-3 days.
Avoid chewing hard foods on the treated tooth until your permanent crown is placed.

faq.Does RCT hurt?: Most patients feel immediate relief fromRCT once the infection is removed. We use local anesthesia to ensure a pain-free experience.
faq.How often should I visit?: We recommend a professional cleaning and check-up every 6 months to prevent major issues.
